exam_scheme.note: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL), a premier Public Sector Enterprise under the Department of Atomic Energy, conducts recruitment for Stipendiary Trainees Category-I (Diploma holders in Engineering / B.Sc.) and Category-II (ITI / HSC). For Category-I, the selection process comprises two stages: Stage 1 is a Written Examination (OMR or Computer Based Test) of 120 minutes duration carrying 100 multiple-choice questions (total 300 marks; +3 marks for correct, -1 mark for wrong). The paper is divided into non-technical subjects (General Awareness, English, Quantitative Aptitude - 40 questions) and engineering discipline domain knowledge (60 questions). Candidates qualifying the written examination are shortlisted in a 1:5 ratio for Stage 2: a personal Technical Interview (100 marks). Final selection is based 100% on performance in the personal Interview, subject to qualifying the written examination and medical fitness standards.

papers.paper_name: Part A Non-Technical (40 Qs) + Part B Technical Domain (60 Qs)
papers.negative_marking: -1 mark for each incorrect response (+3 marks for correct response)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% marks for General/EWS; 30% for SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates to be eligible for interview shortlisting
Minimum 50% marks in interview required for inclusion in final select panel

financial_package.note: During the 2-year institutional training period, Category-I trainees receive a monthly stipend of ₹24,000 in the 1st year and ₹26,000 in the 2nd year plus a one-time book allowance of ₹3,000. Upon successful training completion, trainees are absorbed as Scientific Assistant / B under the Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6 (Entry Basic Pay ₹35,400; range ₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400). In addition to basic pay, employees receive central DA, site allowances / HRA, Transport Allowance, Contributory Health Service Scheme (CHSS), and NPCIL performance incentives.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 6 basic ₹35,400 + 58% DA (₹20,532) + 30% HRA Metro / Site Township Allowance (₹10,620) + Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + ₹2,088 DA on TA) = gross ₹72,240, in-hand ~₹65,000 after 10% NPS deduction.
official_perks: NPCIL residential township accommodation with heavily subsidized electricity, water, and schooling
Contributory Health Service Scheme (CHSS) providing complete medical cover for employee and family
Site allowances and Performance Related Incentive Scheme (PRIS) bonus
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% Employer contribution
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and children education assistance
